resources.string: Turn your body into a game controller. Roaming detects your motion on this device and broadcasts it to other apps.
Hardware step detector plus device tilt. Keep the phone in your hand or pocket.

Roaming needs this permission to detect motion
This device has no step detector; use the camera instead
Private by design: everything runs on this device, there is no network access, no location and no health data is stored.
